entry.title: Chris Pratt, Tom Hopper Talks Realism in 'Terminal List' S2

media:group.media:title: Chris Pratt, Tom Hopper Talks Realism in 'Terminal List' S2
media:group.media:description:
Four years since its first season hit Amazon Prime, Chris Pratt and Tom Hopper join TODAY to discuss the upcoming second season of action thriller series "The Terminal List." They also detail the importance of maintaining accuracy when working with active military personnel. "Behind the camera, we've got real Navy SEALs," Pratt says. "Everything has to, kind of, pass their sniff test. Our whole goal is to make a show that is a love letter to that community, so that the people who have served can watch it and pick up little details. It's a show made for them."

entry.title: Lil Jon on New Memoir, Navigating Grief Over the Loss of His Son

media:group.media:title: Lil Jon on New Memoir, Navigating Grief Over the Loss of His Son
media:group.media:description:
Lil Jon, legendary rapper and music producer, joins TODAY to share details about his first-ever memoir "I Only Shout So You Can Hear Me," which stories his childhood and rise up the Atlanta music scene. The musician also opens up about the discovery that the man who raised him is not his biological father, the loss of his son, and how performing helped him overcome his grief. "I realized I hadn't given myself time to really grieve," he says. "And, that I needed to be on that stage to feel the positivity from the audience and to be on tour and to learn to laugh again with my crew and to just have a good time again."

entry.title: Chris Pratt on 'Terminal List,' Meeting Pope Leo, New Documentary

media:group.media:title: Chris Pratt on 'Terminal List,' Meeting Pope Leo, New Documentary
media:group.media:description:
Chris Pratt joins TODAY to share details about the upcoming second season of his action thriller "The Terminal List," which is hitting Prime Video four years after the release of its first season. The actor also shares details from his meeting with Pope Leo XIV while working on a documentary in honor of the 400th anniversary of St. Peter's Basilica, and reveals his rigorous workout routine and his attraction to high-intensity projects. "I only choose roles that I'm going to have to do push-ups to get in shape," he jokes.
